prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished temporary concept figure for a Nature-style research manuscript, landscape approximately 3:2, pure white, editorial scientific vector-like graphics, Arial typography, charcoal #202A33, muted blue #426C8D, rust #A65E2E and green #477C67. Not a journal cover. Figure 1: Autonomous research and the formation of scientific judgments. Three panels, large lowercase a b c, exceptionally readable labels. a across top: Researcher -> Virtual laboratory -> Evaluator; researcher chooses interventions, measures, repeats and recommends; lab has persistent virtual sample state, accepted/rejected operations, public observations; evaluator independently controls world laws and verifies withheld outcomes. Small elegant line icons of an agent, virtual sample, evaluator; no real physical lab claim, no human-agent collaboration. b bottom left: vertical time sequence Initial expectation -> Self-chosen experiments + note revisions -> Sealed scientific account -> New-intervention forecasts -> Retrospective review. Withheld truth available only to evaluator. c bottom right: clear coverage infographic: Equilibrium and Crystallization, each 5 worlds x 3 information conditions x 3 sessions. Exact summary numbers: 90 sessions; 84 complete chains; 284 note revisions. Label conditions Opaque, Aligned, Misindexed. Separate footer: Broad evidence: 300 campaigns; 6 system families; 5 model configurations. Do not draw invented per-cell completion statuses. All text English, clean typesetting, generous space, no gradients, shadows, logos or Nature wordmark. Small footer text exactly: ImageGen concept preview - not final evidence artwork.

All feasible, lines indicate chronology not a fitted law. Distinguish noiseless retest with diamond. Avoid any invented significance marks. Do not copy text overlaps. Use case: scientific-educational. Create temporary Extended Data Figure 1, polished Nature-style concept scientific diagram, wide 3:2 white, no gradients, Arial, muted blue, rust, charcoal. Three carefully aligned panels with generous whitespace, no text overlap. a Proposed test and actual execution: public note proposes about 2 g cumulative seed; 40 requests x 0.05 g; 1 successful,39 rejected; actual committed total 0.05 g. Draw 1 blue and 39 tiny gray request marks or clean count blocks, clearly distinguish intended versus committed. b Later scientific account: next note says large dose ineffective; later note, sealed account, retrospective review retain that conclusion. Arrows show temporal order, not proven causal influence. Main insight: execution record and evidential claim can diverge. No claim about physical outcome of unexecuted 2 g.
